description: This file provides functions to subscribe and unsubscribe to real-time updates from specific tables ('transactions' and 'alerts') in a Supabase database. It leverages Supabase's real-time channels to listen for database change events filtered by user ID, enabling client components to react to changes in the 'transactions' and 'alerts' tables for a particular user.

methods.name: subscribeToTransactionsRealtime(userId, onChange)
methods.description: Subscribes to real-time changes on the 'transactions' table for a specific user ID. Calls the provided callback with payload data on database events.

methods.name: subscribeToAlertsRealtime(userId, onChange)
methods.description: Subscribes to real-time changes on the 'alerts' table for a specific user ID. Calls the provided callback with payload data on database events.

methods.name: unsubscribeRealtimeChannel(channel)
methods.description: Unsubscribes from a previously subscribed real-time channel.
